results.content: A new Emerson College Polling survey of likely voters finds 40% approve of the job President Trump is doing in the Oval Office, while 56% disapprove. On the generic ballot test, 51% support the Democratic candidate, while 43% support the Republican. Six percent are undecided. [...] Forty-nine percent of voters oppose U.S. military action in Iran, while 36% support it. Since March 2026, those who oppose military action in Iran increased two points, from 47% to 49%, while those who support it decreased four points, from 40% to 36%.
